placements.title: Graceful Degradation When Identifiers Are Absent
placements.frame: What must the derive-id pipeline guarantee when input lacks expected identifier fields?
placements.why: Both expressions cohere around a single thematic subject: how the derive-id pipeline must handle missing-id inputs. src-1 reproduces the production failure pattern (a ## heading with no id field), identifying the defect; src-2 sets the non-negotiable behavioral constraints (must not crash, must produce a valid slug). This names a subject future envelopes will keep feeding — defensive handling of absent identifiers — not a one-time fact.
